text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Look at you two, standing around<n>looking
all serious—what's the big deal?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's just, I was chatting with Ruby at<n>that
corner over there...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
When another student happened to run<n>by and
crash into us. We both had a<n>tumble... Ruby, are
you hurt?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, I'm quite all right. No need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well then consider yourselves lucky,<n>'cause
Magical Girl Sweepy is here!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Twinkle, twinkle, little boo-boo, how I<n>wish you
would go shoo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
May I inquire as to the meaning of... that<n>just
now?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't you tell? ♪ I cast a spell on<n>you to make
the pain go away. Well? I<n>bet you don't feel a
thing anymore, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you're right. Thank you for the<n>charming
spell, Sweep.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, if you ever need anything, me and<n>my
magic are always ready to save the<n>day. ♪
